sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body: Leonidio is a major mainland Greek limestone climbing area around the town of Leonidio.

sections.heading: History and context
warnings: No sourced history and context content found for this pass.

sections.heading: Rock and climbing character
sections.body: The crags are red and grey limestone, with well-bolted single-pitch sport routes and fully bolted longer multi-pitch routes.

sections.heading: Who it suits
sections.body: The sourced grade span supports a wide audience, from low-grade sport climbers to climbers seeking hard routes.

sections.heading: Grades and difficulty
sections.body: Climb Europe reports over 3,000 routes across F3 to F9a+.

sections.heading: Season and conditions
sections.body: The source supports Leonidio as a Mediterranean sport destination; spring, autumn and winter are assigned, while summer heat remains an editorial caution.
